description: Glue Data Catalog KMS Encryption Not Configured for an In-Use Catalog
rationale: At least one Glue database exists and observed CatalogEncryptionMode is DISABLED. This is opt-in KMS governance, not proof that AWS provides no at-rest encryption.
remediation: Where required, enable Glue Data Catalog SSE-KMS or SSE-KMS-WITH-SERVICE-ROLE with approved KMS grants.
